name: autopilot
title: Autopilot
description: Build the tickets one after another without a human in the loop: test-first, shipped as a PR, merged when every check is green, around blocks when safe.
notes:
## Autopilot

Last skill of the Veebee chain (open source, MIT): from a blank page to a shipped product, one skill per step. Takes over from `ticketise`.

**It builds, ships and merges the tickets one after another, without a human in the loop, until something truly blocks.**

- **One confirmation, then silence.** Before the first ticket it checks everything that would stop the night an hour in (clean tree, gh, CI, merge methods, whether `ship-pr-dev` is invocable), then asks once, naming the scope and the base branch. No question after that: whatever needs the user goes in the journal.
- **Next ticket read from disk every time**, by `scripts/queue.py`: done, ready, waiting, blocked, waiting for a human. Pieces in order, tickets by dependency.
- **Test-first.** Uses the `tdd` skill when present: one acceptance criterion at a time, red then green. The seams `tdd` wants confirmed are the acceptance criteria the user already validated in `ticketise`.
- **Checked by use**: after green tests, every criterion is checked in the running product, in a real browser against the design, empty state and error included.
- **Ships through `ship-pr-dev` when it is installed**, a built-in ship otherwise (checks, a cold self-review, the PR, CI watched to green).
- **Merges only on a ready verdict**: every check green on the latest commit, no conflict, no critical, high or medium finding left. A medium finding needs a human, so the PR stays open and the run moves on.
- **Goes around blocks**: skips to tickets that do not depend on the blocked one, and fakes what is missing outside the code (a key, a service) behind a clearly named fake with a ticket to plug the real one. Never fakes money, auth, permissions or personal data. Never bypasses a check: no skipped test, no `--no-verify`, no CI edit, no `--admin`.
- **Stops** when nothing is ready, or when the base branch goes red and one fix does not bring it back.
- **A journal** written as it goes, opening on what waits for the user, and a live board page.

Triggers: "code les tickets", "enchaîne les tickets", "lance l'autopilot", "build the tickets", "run autopilot". Not for cutting tickets: that is `ticketise`.

Optional companions, used when installed: `ship-pr-dev` for each pull request, `tdd` for the loop. No secrets, no environment variables. Source: https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/veebee-skills
